topicName: Cụm từ cố định & Kết hợp từ

rules.rule: 1. Phân biệt Collocations với MAKE và DO:
rules.formula: MAKE: a mistake, an effort, a decision, a difference, friends, progress // DO: homework, housework/chores, research, a favor, good/harm
rules.examples: Don't make mistakes. / She did me a great favor.

rules.rule: 2. Cụm từ cố định với TAKE:
rules.formula: take part in (tham gia), take pride in (tự hào), take advantage of (tận dụng), take care of (chăm sóc)
rules.examples: Take part in sports. / Take advantage of good opportunities.

rules.rule: 3. Cụm từ thông dụng với PAY, CATCH, KEEP, GIVE:
rules.formula: pay attention to (chú ý), catch sb's eye (thu hút ánh nhìn), keep in touch with (giữ liên lạc), give sb a hand (giúp một tay)
rules.examples: Pay attention to the lesson. / Can you give me a hand?

rules.formula: have in common (có điểm chung), in terms of (xét về mặt), on behalf of (thay mặt cho)
rules.examples: They have a lot in common. / In terms of cost, this is better.
